text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The fans vote to decide who is invited to run in the Arima Kinen. Satono Diamond was voted in second, right behind Kitasan Black.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The audience erupts as they make their entrance, but Satono Diamond is just as excited as they are.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond's goal is to become an illustrious runner, and she's ecstatic to race against Kitasan Black as part of achieving that goal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's been chasing after Kitasan Black for so long, and now she finally has the chance to surpass her at the Arima Kinen!
